decisions.reason: Premium customer support is very close to the firm's core managed-hosting promise and likely strengthens retention and differentiation for agency and business customers.
The version management tool fits the firm's in-house platform development and automation strategy and was still presented as part of its active tool suite.

The data-processing-contract tool is comparatively distant from the firm's main hosting and support business, so a medium-sized German provider would likely reallocate effort away from this side line if it is not clearly strategic.
Scalable hosting for agencies is a flagship offering that matches the firm's stated direction, customer base, and core revenue model, making withdrawal unlikely.
